content.title: Dan Orlovsky was so emotional after son's World Autism Awareness Day speech
content.text: SPORTSDan Orlovsky was so emotional after son's World Autism Awareness Day speechMary ClarkeFor The WinApril 2, 2026, 7:46 p.m. ETThursday marked the internationally recognized day of World Autism Awareness and ESPN's "NFL Live" broadcast had a special visitor for the occasion.In a return appearance to the program, Madden Orlovsky — the 14-year-old son of Dan Orlovsky — was part of the afternoon's broadcast after taking part a year ago. Not only that, artwork from Madden Orlovsky was featured on the broadcast, including his drawing of the Philadelphia Eagles logo. Earlier on in the program, Orlovsky received a swag bag of gifts from Eagles wide receiver DeVonta Smith alongside a video message.Then later, Orlovsky sung the Eagles fight song in a moment that had his father in tears from happiness.
